retention.lastConsumer: durable integration commit and clean Git-tree retrieval verification
retention.cleanup: Remove only the transaction root after that consumer passes.

laterConsumer.retrieve: Read the committed maintained-source manifest and deletion record from this integration commit. Compare all 318 byte hashes/sizes and executable flags plus four absences before reusing scoped Maven acceptance. The original source archive retains the tested bytes; apply the documented two-line formatting successor only when reproducing the maintained text. Git preserves executable flags, not owner/group read/write permissions.

linuxWorker.failedPost: Expected retry marker absent; observed completed-part plus newline.
linuxWorker.nativeResults: Previously exported full Maven and musl-preflight evidence remain accepted at their recorded scope.
linuxWorker.retainedRemoteAssets: No longer available through the terminal worker. A successor must retrieve official assets by the recorded identities and applicable caches; do not reuse stale SSH or remote paths.

sourceArchiveRole: Exact accepted verification source; maintained source differs only by the declared one-file formatting successor with identical compiled test bytes.
